items.reason: A gentle, non-active cleanser keeps skin feeling clean without adding to the irritation that can come with stronger products.
A simple ceramide moisturizer supports the look of a comfortable skin barrier, since your moisture score reads on the lower side.
A mineral SPF helps keep the look of marks from darkening further and is gentle on sensitive-looking skin.

response.routine_note: Deep, painful lumps that leave marks are best looked at by a dermatologist, so I haven't picked the strongest actives here because nothing in a shop is a substitute for that visit. In the meantime, cleanse gently morning and night, moisturize, and wear SPF every morning.
